description: Captured from `node extension/server.mjs` on a temp DB (LLMIDE_DB_PATH in TMPDIR, LLMIDE_ENGINE_PREWARM=0), replayed over HTTP. No model call and no external network. Not a live HTTP exchange: the Agent SDK status is produced by sdkStatus() in llm_agent/sdk/updater.mjs, called in-process with an offline fetch stub, because the route reads the npm registry (external). The body is sdkStatus()'s return value, which the route sends verbatim.
